classification.difficultyReason: Identify the highlighted right triangle and calculate its base diagonal before applying Pythagoras again.

content.prompt: Calculate the length of the diagonal $AD$, correct to 1 d.p.

spec.description: Triangular prism with the calculation triangle ACD highlighted. Source blue ordinary edges become black; hidden red edges and meaningful triangle highlighting are retained in the standard palette.
spec.mathematics: AB=12 cm, BC=8 cm, CD=4 cm; AC is a base diagonal and AD is the requested diagonal.
